items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: But I took, when my youngest son, Mark, when he was maybe six or something

ctx.x: I’m glad you brought it up because I was going to ask what did your children think of what their dad did?

Well I’m not sure they knew all the time. And it’s funny, the older two kids were very shy and retiring. And the younger two were very outgoing so when they’d meet people they’d say, “It’s nice to meet you” and everything. And the other ones were shy to meet people. But I took, when my youngest son, Mark, when he was maybe six or something, his entire world became the Empire State Building. The Empire State Building became the symbol of strength, height, sophistication, it became everything. When you say, “That’s…
That’s amazing. I’ve really enjoyed this conversation and I want to congratulate you on like creating your own niche it seems like.
